title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot can now answer questions about opened Copilot Pages in chat
description: When using Copilot Pages side-by-side in Copilot Chat, you can now ask questions in chat about your open page, and Copilot will provide answers based on the contents of that page.
